# CR-9203: Acme Manufacturing credit limit to $1,000,000

**Short answer:** Acme qualifies for a $1,000,000 limit with the parent guarantee. The limit needs approval from Elena Novak (Director of Finance) and concurrence from Michael Torres (VP Sales). However, **CR-9203 is not in the system of record.** It must be confirmed before anyone acts on this decision.

## 1. The request
- **As given:** CR-9203. The customer is ERP C-1001. The limit would go from $250,000 to $1,000,000. Sarah Chen requested it on 2026-09-23. It relies on the Acme Group parent guarantee.
- **Not in the system of record:** `credit_requests.csv` has no CR-9203. The only pending Acme request is **CR-9201**, which raises the limit from $250,000 to $400,000. It was raised the same day and does not mention the guarantee (Sarah's email to Priya confirms it). I have decided CR-9203 as given and have not substituted CR-9201.
- **Current limit:** ERP shows $250,000 (`erp_credit.csv`), which matches the request.

## 2. The customer
Acme Mfg. Holdings (ERP C-1001) is the same company as Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048). They share the same DUNS number (04-812-7730) and address. CRM records the account tier as **Strategic**. Acme Industrial Supply Co. (C-1044 / CRM-2091) is a different company.

## 3. The policy
Northstar Credit Policy 2026 (CREDIT-POLICY-2026) is in effect from 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.

## 4. Payment history
The rule is that no invoice due in the previous 12 months may have been paid, or left unpaid, more than 30 days after its due date.

| Invoice | Due | Paid | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-60412 | 2025-11-28 | 2025-11-24 | On time |
| INV-62011 | 2026-07-25 | 2026-07-22 | On time |
| INV-62305 | 2026-10-02 | Unpaid | Not yet due on 2026-09-23 |

No invoices were late.

## 5. Maximum limit
- The maximum for a Strategic account is $750,000.
- Guarantee GRT-ACME-2026 from Acme Group Holdings, Inc. names Acme Mfg. Holdings. It runs from 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31, so it was in force on 2026-09-23. It covers $400,000.
- The maximum is therefore **$1,150,000**. The requested $1,000,000 is within it.

## 6. The requestor's authority
Sarah Chen is an Enterprise Account Executive. The credit policy gives that role no approval authority. She also submitted the request, so she could not approve it in any case.

## 7. Required approvers
- A limit above $500,000 needs the **Director of Finance**: Elena Novak.
- A Strategic account above $500,000 also needs **VP Sales concurrence**: Michael Torres.
- Neither of them submitted the request, so the separation-of-duties rule is satisfied.

## 8. Decision
**APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION.** This is subject to confirming that CR-9203 exists in Northstar ERP, and to reconciling it with the pending CR-9201.

```json
{
  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "CR-9203", "customer": "Acme Mfg. Holdings (ERP C-1001) / Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048)", "current_limit": 250000, "requested_limit": 1000000,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "sarah.chen@northstar.example", "basis": "guarantee"},
  "eligibility": {"status": "eligible", "maximum_limit": 1150000,
                  "basis": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026 §5: Strategic maximum $750,000 + parent guarantee GRT-ACME-2026 $400,000 (names Acme Mfg. Holdings, in force 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31); no invoice due in prior 12 months paid or unpaid >30 days after due date",
                  "late_invoices": []},
  "authority": {"policy": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": null, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Director of Finance, with VP Sales concurrence (Strategic account, limit > $500,000)",
                "approvers": [{"name": "Elena Novak", "role": "Director of Finance", "kind": "approval"},
                              {"name": "Michael Torres", "role": "VP Sales", "kind": "concurrence"}]},
  "evidence": ["structured/credit_requests.csv (no CR-9203; CR-9201 pending for C-1001 at $400,000)",
               "structured/erp_credit.csv (C-1001 limit $250,000)",
               "structured/customers.csv (C-1001 Acme Mfg. Holdings, DUNS 04-812-7730)",
               "structured/crm_accounts.csv (CRM-2048 Acme Manufacturing, Strategic, DUNS 04-812-7730)",
               "structured/erp_invoices.csv (INV-60412, INV-62011 paid on time; INV-62305 due 2026-10-02)",
               "documents/credit_policy_2026.md",
               "documents/acme_parent_guarantee.md (GRT-ACME-2026, $400,000, 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31)",
               "structured/employees.csv and documents/organization_chart.md",
               "documents/email_sarah_to_priya.md"],
  "missing_evidence": ["CR-9203 record in Northstar ERP"],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Confirm request CR-9203 (C-1001, $250,000 to $1,000,000, 2026-09-23) exists in Northstar ERP; it is not in the credit request records", "who": "Finance (Elena Novak)", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "Reconcile with pending request CR-9201 for the same customer ($250,000 to $400,000, same date) so that only one limit change is acted on", "who": "Sarah Chen / Finance", "blocking": true}
  ]
}
```
